label: Fat Loss
description: The reduction of body fat over time, usually inferred through bodyweight trend, measurements, performance context and adherence data.

label: Scale Weight
description: The user's measured bodyweight. It is an imperfect proxy for fat loss because it includes water, glycogen, gut content and lean mass.

label: Weight Trend
description: The direction of bodyweight over time, usually assessed using rolling averages rather than single weigh-ins.

label: Expected Weight Loss
description: Estimated weight change based on the user's calorie deficit and assumed energy cost of body mass loss.

label: Observed Weight Loss
description: Actual trend in bodyweight over a defined period.

label: Expected vs Observed Mismatch
description: The gap between expected weight loss and observed weight loss.

label: Energy Balance
description: The relationship between energy intake and energy expenditure.

label: Calories In
description: Daily energy intake recorded by the user.

label: Calories Out
description: Total energy expenditure from basal metabolism, movement, training and thermic effect of food.

label: Steps
description: Daily step count used as a practical proxy for low-level activity and NEAT.

label: NEAT
description: Non-exercise activity thermogenesis. This includes walking, fidgeting, posture and general daily movement.

label: Training Load
description: A simple user-recorded marker of training stress.

label: Exercise Energy Expenditure
description: Energy expended through structured training.

label: Protein Intake
description: Daily protein intake, used as a marker of diet quality, satiety and muscle retention support.

label: Carbohydrate Intake
description: Daily carbohydrate intake. Changes in carbohydrate intake can alter glycogen and water storage.

label: Fat Intake
description: Daily fat intake, part of total calorie intake and dietary adherence.

label: Adherence
description: How consistently the user follows their planned calorie, protein and activity targets.

label: Logging Accuracy
description: The accuracy and completeness of user-entered food and activity data.

label: Weekend Drift
description: A pattern where calories or activity meaningfully change at weekends compared with weekdays.

label: Water Retention
description: Temporary increases in body water that can hide fat loss on the scale.

label: Glycogen
description: Stored carbohydrate in muscle and liver. Glycogen changes can alter scale weight through associated water storage.

label: Gut Content
description: Food and waste mass in the digestive tract, which can influence short-term scale weight.

label: Sleep
description: Sleep duration and quality, used as a proxy for recovery, stress regulation and water retention risk.

label: Sleep Quality
description: A subjective rating of how well the user slept.

label: Recovery
description: The body's ability to recover from training, dieting and daily stress.

label: Stress
description: Psychological or physiological stress that may influence appetite, adherence, sleep and water retention.

label: Weight Volatility
description: The degree of short-term fluctuation in scale weight.

label: Plateau
description: A period where weight trend appears flat despite a reported deficit.

label: True Plateau
description: A likely real stall in fat loss where expected loss and observed trend remain aligned poorly for long enough that masking is less likely.

label: Masked Fat Loss
description: A diagnosis where fat loss may be occurring but scale weight is temporarily hidden by water, glycogen or gut content.

label: Reduced Expenditure
description: A diagnosis where activity, NEAT or training energy may have fallen enough to reduce the expected calorie deficit.

label: Adherence Drift
description: A diagnosis where inconsistent calorie intake or incomplete logging may explain the gap between expected and observed weight loss.

label: Recovery Masking
description: A diagnosis where poor sleep, higher training stress or broader recovery strain may be increasing weight volatility and water retention.

label: Training Inflammation
description: Temporary inflammation and fluid retention caused by hard training, muscle damage or unusually high training load.

label: Sodium Intake
description: Dietary sodium intake. Higher or inconsistent sodium can increase short-term water retention and scale weight volatility.

label: Carbohydrate Shift
description: A meaningful change in carbohydrate intake that can alter glycogen storage and associated body water.

label: Stress Load
description: Psychological or physiological stress that can affect sleep, recovery, appetite, adherence and water retention.

label: Poor Sleep Recovery
description: A recovery state where poor sleep duration or quality reduces readiness and may contribute to water retention.

label: Alcohol Intake
description: Alcohol intake, which can affect sleep quality, hydration, appetite, adherence and short-term bodyweight.

label: Gut Content Load
description: Short-term digestive mass from food volume, fibre, meal timing or bowel regularity that can influence scale weight.

label: Illness Inflammation
description: Inflammatory load from illness or immune stress that may increase water retention and disturb weight trend interpretation.

label: Recovery-Driven Water Retention
description: Water retention primarily driven by poor recovery, hard training, poor sleep or stress load.

label: Dietary Water Retention
description: Water retention primarily driven by carbohydrate, sodium, alcohol or digestive changes.
